description: INSIGHT template (Pulse: Bar Chart) — horizontal bars of an aggregated measure across the members of a categorical dimension, limited to the Top 50 members by the measure and sorted DESC (biggest bar first). No color encoding. Templatized from the hand-authored 'Sheet 2' bar worksheet.
avoid_when: The x-axis should be a CONTINUOUS TIME field (a trend over time) — use insight-unusual-change / trend-line-chart instead. This template compares a measure across DISCRETE categorical members, not across time.

slots.purpose: Categorical dimension whose members become the bars (on rows). The bars are sorted DESC by the measure.
slots.notes: Bound to TWO references that must stay in sync: the rows pill [none:{{field_base_1}}:nk] and the <shelf-sort-v2 dimension-to-sort=...>. Rebinding must update both.

slots.purpose: Aggregated measure that gives each bar its length (on cols = horizontal bars) and the DESC sort key.
slots.notes: On cols so bars run horizontally. Also referenced by <shelf-sort-v2 measure-to-sort-by=...>; rebinding must update both.

hazards.detail: The <shelf-sort-v2 direction='DESC' ...> ranks bars biggest-first — the defining feature of this insight ('top contributors'). Preserve the shelf-sort block; rebinding category/measure must update BOTH its dimension-to-sort and measure-to-sort-by, or the sort silently reverts to alphabetical.

Measure on <cols> and dimension on <rows> produces HORIZONTAL bars. Do not swap them; a vertical column chart is a different shape. Do NOT add a color encoding on the same dimension already on rows — the redundant-color-encoding preflight rule rejects it.

The categorical Top-50 filter (<groupfilter count='50' end='top' ...> ordered by SUM([{{field_base_2}}]) DESC) limits the view to the 50 biggest members. Its inner expression references the measure by BASE NAME (SUM([{{field_base_2}}])), NOT a datasource-qualified id — so rebinding the measure must also rewrite that expression. Two known failure modes: (1) if the measure is not rebound in the expression the Top-N silently drops on apply and ALL members render; (2) on the whole-workbook apply path a published (sqlproxy) datasource gets cloned to '(copy)', and the filter's base ref no longer matches the bound (copy) datasource, so Desktop drops the filter — the same symptom that made an earlier Top-20 vanish. Verify member count after apply.
